Mia (devex): quick note: onboarding partner hit a problem — Go sampleapp prints full x-request-id in debug logs even when REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true and OTEL enabled.
Sam L: can you paste the log chunk?
Mia (devex): short excerpt:
2026-03-22T08:14:02Z INFO sampleapp v0.9.2 ENV: REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true LOG_LEVEL=debug OTEL_ENABLED=1
2026-03-22T08:14:03Z DEBUG http.server request_id=9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c path=/v1/generate
2026-03-22T08:14:03Z DEBUG otel.span trace_id=aa22bb... request_id=9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c
Priya (eng-runtime): sounds like middleware ordering. handler-level debug runs before logging middleware sanitizes headers. Python had same bug earlier.
Julian R: short term: add unconditional header sanitizer at top of ServeHTTP when REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true. long term: reorder middleware so logging wrapper is outermost.
Sam L: also update sampleapp README to document the OTEL+REDACT interaction and recommend LOG_LEVEL=info for safe onboarding.
Mia (devex): QA expected string to assert: DEBUG http.server request_id=[REDACTED] path=/v1/generate — will add to test matrix.
ci-bot: created PR #1452 (telemetry: sanitize headers early). CI triggered.
Mia (devex): thanks — I'll update onboarding docs after PR lands. :thumbsup:
